headline: Resolution on Fire Department emergency response protocols and the condition of Fire Headquarters, plus litigation settlements and two common victualler's license petitions.
summary: The agenda also lists board and commission appointments and a resolution to invite applicants to the Human Rights Commission. It includes committee reports, and a city messenger appointment that was tabled on January 6, 2026.
items: Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee report on item 25-095
Public Works and Facilities Committee report, November 18, 2026
Petition for common victualler's license, Tuam Holdings LLC DBA Rory O'Connors
Petition for common victualler's license, Forteva LLC DBA May's Cafe
Resolution to invite applicants to the Human Rights Commission
Resolution requesting information and public discussion on Medford Fire Department emergency response protocols and the condition of Fire Headquarters
Appointment of a City Messenger for 2026 and 2027
University accountability report (next report due May 2027)
Quarterly presentation on city's financial health by Chief Financial Officer/Auditor
Monthly copy of warrant articles from Chief Financial Officer/Auditor
